findings.summary: The specified midpoint graph H_k has exact CKR value (7k-6)/(8(k-1)); the feasible midpoint embedding gives this value, and the constant-vector subgradient certificate proves matching optimality.
For every integer k>=3, OPT(H_k)=1. The local lemma is exactly certified by exhaustive enumeration, the averaging argument proves the lower bound, and the stated labeling attains it.
The committed H_4 instance has 10 vertices and 24 edges, with CKR=11/12, integral optimum 1, and ratio 12/11. Exhaustion of all 4^6 nonterminal assignments independently checks the finite instance.
The H_k family has ratio 8(k-1)/(7k-6), tending to 8/7. It therefore supplies the classical lower bounds Gamma_k>=8(k-1)/(7k-6) and Gamma>=8/7, but this is weaker than the governed benchmark.

The transaction does not improve the bracket 1.20016<=Gamma<=1.2787: its four-terminal ratio is 12/11 and the family's supremum is 8/7, both below 1.20016, while no universal rounding argument or upper bound below 1.2787 is supplied.
